playlist.playlist_description:
“Who is to bring the knowledge that will answer the great life questions that perplex humanity?” According to Dallas Willard, “The primary responsibility to teach falls upon those who self-identify as spokespeople for Christ…”

The "Knowing Christ" conference was hosted by the Dallas Willard Center in Santa Barbara, California, February 21-23, 2013. Dallas Willard and John Ortberg took turns teaching, and at the end of each session John moderated a wonderful dialogue with Dallas, teasing out further insight and clarity about the topics at hand. Links to the outlines distributed to the conference participants can be downloaded from each session description.

The plan for the gathering was to assist pastors (spokespeople for Christ) in fully entering into the joy, power, and dignity of the role assigned to them by Christ, to be the teachers of the nations. The conference focused on knowledge for living and the disastrous effects of divorcing the teachings of Jesus Christ and his people from the domain of human knowledge. It was designed to help pastors and other Christian leaders present a clearer picture of how to live well and how to "do" church.

These session recordings were released in DVD and audio, and transcribed in book form under the title "Living in Christ's Presence." Learn more about the book and about the leader's guide on our website: https://dwillard.org/resources/books/living-in-christs-presence
